fact: The March 2023 evaluation of Togo's 2018-2022 SNIS strengthening plan reports DHIS2 with electronic tools deployed at primary care units and district hospitals (100% achieved) and community level (95%), while a patient record system for regional and university hospitals stood at 20%.
title: Rapport final d'évaluation du Plan Stratégique de Renforcement du SNIS 2018-2022
publisher: Ministère de la Santé, de l'Hygiène publique et de l'Accès universel aux soins, Togo
